name: African Union

flag.description: A green field with a green map of Africa in the centre, set in a burst of white rays and ringed by small gold five-pointed stars.
flag.symbolism: Green stands for Africa's hopes, gold for its wealth and bright future, white for purity, and the stars for the member states; the map is drawn without borders as a sign of unity.

hook: The African Union puts the whole continent on its flag: a borderless map of Africa glowing with white sunrays on green, inside a ring of gold stars.
trivia: The African Union replaced the Organisation of African Unity, which had been founded in Addis Ababa in 1963.
It is one of the few flags to show a map, along with those of Cyprus and Kosovo.
